title: Mycroft Finance Investigator Materiality Approval
description: A named human's decision on the materiality threshold, bound to the exact finance pack it was judged against. The agent may prepare the request; it may never author this decision.

decision.description: APPROVE_DEMO keeps the fixture amount but puts a name against it. REPLACE substitutes a different, stated amount.

approved_by.description: A named human. Agent identities are refused at validation.

reasoning.description: The basis for the amount. An approval without reasoning is not an approval.

approved_amount.description: Required for REPLACE and must differ from the demo amount. Omitted or equal for APPROVE_DEMO.

source_hashes.description: SHA-256 of every verified source file, as recorded in the approval request.
